\caption[Master results table.]{Master results table: per-cell medians for every (problem, dimension, budget, algorithm) cell of the benchmark grid. \mw{} values are computed from the independent final sample drawn from the frozen final mixture with the remaining budget (\(M\) weighted draws), charged at the total cost \(C_{\mathrm{total}} = C_{\mathrm{adapt}} + M\), which equals the nominal budget \(\Nlike\) for every available run; \(489\) of the \(795\) \mw{} runs (\(28\) of the \(45\) (problem, dimension, budget) combinations) have a within-budget final estimate. Columns: available/total seeds (for \mw{}: seeds with a final estimate; for the other algorithms: admissible seeds); median cost-efficiency \(\effic = \neff/\Nlike\) (for \mw{}: Kish \(\neff\) of the final sample per unit of \(C_{\mathrm{total}}\)); median marginal Wasserstein-1 error \(\wonebar\); median sliced Wasserstein distance; median absolute log-evidence error \(|\Delta\log\evidence|\) (evidence-aware algorithms only; for \mw{} the ordinary importance-sampling evidence of the final sample); median absolute quantile error at the median and at the \(97.5\,\%\) level (coordinate-averaged absolute deviations in the parameter's own units, smaller is better, \cref{subsec:bench-coverage}; on the smooth \mridges{} cells the central level is ill-conditioned, because the true median of each bimodal coordinate falls in the valley between two symmetric modes, and the outer level is the meaningful calibration number there, \cref{sec:bench-results-calibration}); median partition-mass error \(\mathrm{TV}_{\mathrm{part}}\) (\mridges{} and \mridgesspiky{} only, \cref{subsec:bench-recovery}; for \mw{} computed from the native weights of the final sample, for the other algorithms from the reported output; per-seed values in \texttt{experiments/out/revision\_2026-09-25/partition\_mass.csv} of the companion repository, estimator \texttt{fresh} and \texttt{output}). ``--'' marks metrics that are undefined for the cell or cells without an available run; \(0/n\) rows carry the exclusion reason as a superscript (\textsuperscript{r}: all seeds failed the \(\rhat < 1.05\) gate; \textsuperscript{b}: all seeds violated the budget band; \textsuperscript{i}: budget-infeasible, the minimal complete run exceeds \(1.2\,\Nlike\); \textsuperscript{f}: no within-budget final sample, the adaptation alone consumed the budget; combinations are listed).}\label{tab:master-results}\\
